From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: 
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Wavefront mutual-action plan & proposed milestone calendar

Hi Aiden / Samantha —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) and companion SOW snapshot to help us align on a Phase 1 delivery window and responsibilities. High-level asks below — I put owners next to each milestone so we can hand off cleanly into CS and Eng.

Key milestones (Phase 1 / 8 weeks):
- Kickoff & access provisioning — target: 2026-05-26 — owner: Wavefront (provisioning contact) / Redwood (irene_choi)
- Data ingestion spike & schema validation — target: 2026-06-02 to 2026-06-09 — owner: Wavefront (data team) / Redwood (eng lead)
- Integration test & performance check — target: 2026-06-16 — owner: Redwood (karthik_iyer)
- Acceptance run & acceptance criteria review — target: 2026-06-23 — owner: Wavefront (product) / Redwood (marissa_cole)
- Go-live window (soft launch) — target: 2026-06-30 — owner: Wavefront operations / Redwood on-call

Open items we need from Wavefront to finalize the MAP:
1) Primary provisioning contact (for accounts/keys).
2) Procurement point of contact + estimated PO timeline.
3) Any regulatory or IP constraints for logs/retention beyond standard 30 days.

Attachments: Wavefront_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v0.1.xlsx (milestones + owner cells), SOW_Wavefront_v1.pdf (pricing / billing notes).

Can you review the milestones above and flag anything that looks risky from your side? If this looks broadly feasible, we can lock dates and Marissa (CC'd) will schedule the kickoff.

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales (Redwood Inference)
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com

Thanks Irene — this is helpful. Quick questions: 

- For "Data ingestion spike" can we move the validation window one week later? Our data team has a scheduled maintenance the week of 6/1 and we'd prefer to validate 6/8–6/15 if possible.
- What are the explicit acceptance criteria for the 6/23 acceptance run? We want to be certain the test cases and SLAs are defined so our QA can sign off.
- Procurement contact: please hold until I confirm with our finance lead (Paul Hsu) — I'll share Paul on the next thread.

If we shift the ingestion validation a week, will that push downstream milestones? Looking forward to Marissa's scheduling suggestion.

—Aiden

Subject: Re: Wavefront mutual-action plan & proposed milestone calendar — CS runbook items

Hi all — looping in as I'll be the CS owner for the Wavefront relationship during onboarding. Thanks for the draft, Irene. A couple of suggestions from a handoff and acceptance perspective: 

Proposed adjustments:
- Move "Data ingestion spike" to 2026-06-08 — 2026-06-15 (agrees with Aiden).
- Acceptance criteria (Phase 1): 1) 95% of sample queries return within agreed latency (p50/p95 targets in SOW), 2) no data-loss on a 72-hour ingestion window, 3) 3 successful end-to-end runs of the canonical test set. We'll capture the test set in the MAP.
- Add a 1-week buffer between acceptance review (6/23) and soft launch (now target 7/07) to allow for any hotfixes.

Proposed timeline (updated):
- Kickoff: 2026-05-26 (virtual, 60m) — action: schedule calendar invite + pre-kickoff checklist due 48h prior.
- Data ingestion validation: 2026-06-08 — 2026-06-15 — owner: Wavefront data lead (TBD).
- Integration test / perf: 2026-06-22 — owner: Redwood eng (karthik_iyer).
- Acceptance review: 2026-06-29 — owner: marissa_cole (CS).
- Soft launch: 2026-07-07 — owner: Wavefront operations / Redwood on-call.

I've attached Wavefront_MAP_comments.xlsx with inline owner calls and the acceptance checklist. Aiden — if you can provide Paul Hsu as procurement contact, we'll queue the SOW for signature and generate a DocuSign link.

I'll schedule the kickoff for 2026-05-26 10:00 AM PT and will send invites once we confirm attendees.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
